closeout.summary: Gallery Hero is feature-local with its public package and Astro facades, stored nine-field contract, renderer behavior, theme hooks, image and fallback behavior, and both safe CTA paths preserved. Product and test source 0359ee917d4a636258a824820ae1de7488874af6 passed quick, focused Chromium, and full verification; proof-only head a6c653565876b3876358e7a63a2f1c1d0a8853f5 passed exact-head quick checks and OpenClaw with zero findings. ClawSweeper accepted the external media as sufficient proof; its request to delete required durable GrillTrack history was adjudicated reject_false_positive. PR #40 merged as 0259df4a1460b0e6a429f5a4f47c5dbbd3f05224. No unresolved Gallery Hero decision remains.

decisions.question: Lock Gallery Hero as the third feature-local pilot under the cumulative CTA Band and Page Hero contracts?
decisions.rationale: Gallery Hero is the smallest adjacent increase in boundary pressure: it repeats the proven two-path safe-link seam while adding one bounded media-picker, image-alt, rendering, and fallback contract without repeaters or shared-policy redesign.
